import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD_REAC = -3;
    static final int CAPS = ROOM;

    static int[][] cells = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] podCount = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] venom = new int[61][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static class Point {
        int x, y, number;
        Point(int a, int b, int c) {
            x = a; y = b; number = c;
        }
    }

    static List<Point> survivors = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Point> pods = new ArrayList<>();

    static boolean isRoom(int x, int y, int N) {
        return x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && cells[x][y] == ROOM;
    }

    static int cellType(char c) {
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return ROOM;
        if (c == 'Y') return REAC;
        if (c == 'Z') return BAD_REAC;
        return -1;
    }

    static int cellValue(char c) {
        return c - '0';
    }

    static void propagateVenom(int startX, int startY, int T, int N) {
        venom[0][startX][startY] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                    if (venom[t - 1][i][j] == 1) {
                        venom[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = i + dx[d];
                            int ny = j + dy[d];
                            if (isRoom(nx, ny, N)) {
                                venom[t][nx][ny] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int distTo(Point a, Point b, int N, int limit) {
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[N][N];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, a.x, a.y});
        visited[a.x][a.y] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int time = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            if (x == b.x && y == b.y) return time;
            if (time == limit) continue;
            if (venom[time][x][y] == 1) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (isRoom(nx, ny, N) && !visited[nx][ny] && venom[time][nx][ny] == 0) {
                    visited[nx][ny] = true;
                    q.add(new int[]{time + 1, nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static class Dinic {
        class Edge {
            int to, rev, cap, flow;
            Edge(int t, int r, int c) {
                to = t; rev = r; cap = c; flow = 0;
            }
        }

        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> graph;
        int[] level, ptr;

        Dinic(int _n) {
            n = _n;
            graph = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
            Edge a = new Edge(v, graph.get(v).size(), capacity);
            Edge b = new Edge(u, graph.get(u).size(), 0);
            graph.get(u).add(a);
            graph.get(v).add(b);
        }

        boolean buildLevels(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            level[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int sendFlow(int u, int t, int pushed) {
            if (u == t) return pushed;
            for (int cid = ptr[u]; cid < graph.get(u).size(); ++cid) {
                Edge e = graph.get(u).get(cid);
                if (e.flow < e.cap && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                    int tr = sendFlow(e.to, t, Math.min(pushed, e.cap - e.flow));
                    if (tr > 0) {
                        e.flow += tr;
                        graph.get(e.to).get(e.rev).flow -= tr;
                        return tr;
                    }
                }
                ptr[u]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (buildLevels(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = sendFlow(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        Point bad = new Point(0, 0, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine().trim();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = cellType(ch);
                int num = cellValue(ch);
                cells[i][j] = type;
                if (type == ROOM && num > 0) {
                    survivors.add(new Point(i, j, num));
                }
                if (type == BAD_REAC) {
                    bad = new Point(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine().trim();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = cellType(ch);
                int num = cellValue(ch);
                if (type == CAPS && num > 0) {
                    pods.add(new Point(i, j, num));
                    podCount[i][j] = num;
                }
            }
        }

        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(MAXN);
        int source = 0;
        int sink = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < survivors.size(); ++i) {
            dinic.addEdge(source, i * 2 + 1, survivors.get(i).number);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < pods.size(); ++i) {
            dinic.addEdge(i * 2 + 2, sink, pods.get(i).number);
        }

        propagateVenom(bad.x, bad.y, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < survivors.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < pods.size(); ++j) {
                int t = distTo(survivors.get(i), pods.get(j), N, T);
                if (t <= T) {
                    dinic.addEdge(i * 2 + 1, j * 2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(source, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
